sn46.44:1.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn46.44:1.2: duppañño eḷamūgo duppañño eḷamūgoti bhante vuccati
sn46.44:1.3: kittāvatā nu kho bhante duppañño eḷamūgoti vuccatīti.
sn46.44:1.4: sattannaṃ kho bhikkhu bojjhaṅgānaṃ abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā duppañño eḷamūgoti vuccati.
sn46.44:1.7: imesaṃ kho bhikkhu sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgānaṃ abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā duppañño eḷamūgoti vuccatīti.
